subject.title: [Bug]: All channels enter broken state after 2026.6.11 update — one message per session then permanent silence

question: Should #101814 remain the broad v2026.6.11 all-channel incident tracker until stable-package, WebChat, WhatsApp replay, and stuck-recovery proof are correlated, or should it be split/closed under existing narrower trackers now?
rationale: The issue overlaps #98416, #97983, #97538/#99365, #84903, and #102006, but none currently proves the full reported stable failure is fixed; the canonical tracking shape requires maintainer incident triage.

options.title: Keep Broad Incident Tracker
options.body: Keep this issue open until maintainers correlate stable package parity, WebChat dispatch, WhatsApp replay, and stuck-session recovery proof against the same v2026.6.11 symptom set.

options.title: Split Into Narrow Canonicals
options.body: Move the WebChat, WhatsApp replay, package parity, and stuck-recovery pieces into existing canonical issues and close this only after each has an owner and proof target.

options.title: Treat as Package-Parity Duplicate
options.body: Close under #98416 only if maintainers decide the reply-session package-parity bug fully explains the all-channel silence and duplicate-reply behavior.

recommendation.title: Keep Broad Incident Tracker
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until maintainers correlate stable package parity, WebChat dispatch, WhatsApp replay, and stuck-session recovery proof against the same v2026.6.11 symptom set.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses latest stable release state, beta package proof, and adjacent durable replay/session recovery surfaces.
